description: DCAS Managed Building Fuel Usage (Historical) is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. The fuel usage of each DCAS managed building. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are facilities management, department of citywide administrative services, dcas, building, oil usage. The table has 17 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS). The portal shows 2017-09-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
